confidence: Moderate suspicion of two admitted glass handlers; low confidence in unique culprit. Statements lack timestamps and independent observation.
plausibility_notes: Three characters score strictly above 5: Monet, Brie, Chip.
Glass movement has plausible paper/spill explanations, creating useful uncertainty.
Most statements establish confrontation and paper delivery rather than timed opportunity; relation to 6:40-6:44 remains unclear.
Almost everyone brings a document, conceals another document, and delivers a witty threat. Repetition feels constructed to fit a grid.
If confrontations fit one short private-service interval, the evening is implausibly congested. Timing and dinner-place versus salon geography need clarification.
Additional concealed misdeeds extend the everyone-is-compromised pattern.
Preparation paper collections do not yet establish access to visitor-side poison shelf.
Offices, crews, loading routes suggest alibis without their times or independent verification.
